question: Can you tell me the numeric value of the active council district in Austin which has the highest number of bike trips that start and end within the same district, but not at the same station?
sql:
WITH active_stations AS (
  SELECT station_id, council_district
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations`
  WHERE status = 'active'
)
SELECT s1.council_district, COUNT(*) AS trip_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN active_stations s1 ON t.start_station_id = s1.station_id
JOIN active_stations s2 ON CAST(t.end_station_id AS INT64) = s2.station_id
WHERE t.start_station_id != CAST(t.end_station_id AS INT64)
  AND s1.council_district = s2.council_district
  AND t.start_time >= '2014-01-01' AND t.start_time < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY s1.council_district
